/* Vocabulary */
function renderVocab(){renderVocabStudy();$('#vStudyBtn').onclick=()=>{$('#vStudyBtn').classList.add('active');$('#vPracticeBtn').classList.remove('active');renderVocabStudy()};$('#vPracticeBtn').onclick=()=>{$('#vPracticeBtn').classList.add('active');$('#vStudyBtn').classList.remove('active');renderVocabPractice()}}
function renderVocabStudy(){const saved=new Set((getStored().vocab||[]));$('#vocabHost').innerHTML=`<div class="vocab-grid">${DATA.vocabulary.map(v=>`<article class="vocab-card"><div class="vocab-word">${escapeHtml(v.headword)}</div><div class="vocab-meta">${escapeHtml(v.type)}</div><p>${escapeHtml(v.definition)}</p><p><b>UZ:</b> ${escapeHtml(v.uzbek)}</p><div class="vocab-context"><b>Listening context:</b> ${escapeHtml(v.context)}</div><p><b>Collocations:</b> ${v.collocations.map(escapeHtml).join(', ')}</p><p><b>Paraphrases:</b> ${v.paraphrases.map(escapeHtml).join(', ')}</p><button class="btn" onclick="pronounce('${v.headword.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')">🔊 Pronounce</button> <button class="btn" onclick="saveWord('${v.headword.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')">${saved.has(v.headword)?'Saved':'＋ Vocabulary'}</button></article>`).join('')}</div>`}
function pronounce(w){if('speechSynthesis'in window){speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(w);u.lang='en-GB';speechSynthesis.speak(u)}}
function saveWord(w){const o=getStored();o.vocab=o.vocab||[];if(!o.vocab.includes(w))o.vocab.push(w);try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(o))}catch(e){}toast('Saved to Vocabulary');renderVocabStudy()}
function renderVocabPractice(){let score=0,idx=0;const items=[...DATA.vocabulary].sort(()=>.5-Math.random()).slice(0,10);function one(){if(idx>=items.length){$('#vocabHost').innerHTML=`<div class="panel"><h2>Vocabulary Practice</h2><p>Score: <b>${score}/${items.length}</b></p><button class="btn primary" id="againV">Practice again</button></div>`;$('#againV').onclick=renderVocabPractice;return}const v=(window.laVocabUnit=items[idx].headword,items[idx]),wrong=DATA.vocabulary.filter(x=>x.headword!==v.headword).sort(()=>.5-Math.random()).slice(0,3),opts=[v,...wrong].sort(()=>.5-Math.random());$('#vocabHost').innerHTML=`<div class="practice-card"><div class="muted">${idx+1}/${items.length}</div><h2>${escapeHtml(v.definition)}</h2><p>Which word matches this definition?</p><div class="practice-options">${opts.map(o=>`<button class="practice-option" data-vopt="${escapeHtml(o.headword)}">${escapeHtml(o.headword)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;$$('[data-vopt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(b.dataset.vopt===v.headword)score++;idx++;one()})}one()}
function getNotes(){try{return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(NOTES_KEY)||'{}')}catch{return {}}}
function setNotes(notes){try{sessionStorage.setItem(NOTES_KEY,JSON.stringify(notes))}catch(e){}}
function syncNotePanel(){const notes=getNotes(),q=String(state.currentQ);$('#noteQuestionLabel').textContent=`Question ${q}`;$('#noteTextarea').value=notes[q]||'';$('#noteSaved').textContent=notes[q]?'Saved for this session':''}
function openNotes(){syncNotePanel();$('#noteModal').classList.remove('hidden');setTimeout(()=>$('#noteTextarea').focus(),20)}
function saveCurrentNote(){const notes=getNotes(),q=String(state.currentQ),v=$('#noteTextarea').value.trim();if(v)notes[q]=v;else delete notes[q];setNotes(notes);$('#noteSaved').textContent=v?'Saved for this session':'Note cleared';updateNav()}
function closeNotes(){const m=$('#noteModal');if(!m||m.classList.contains('hidden'))return;saveCurrentNote();m.classList.add('hidden')}
function clearCurrentNote(){$('#noteTextarea').value='';saveCurrentNote()}

/* Retry */
function renderRetry(){if(!state.results.length){const o=getStored();state.results=o.lastResults||[];state.attemptStatus=o.attemptStatus||'none'}if(!state.results.length){$('#retryHost').innerHTML='<div class="panel"><b>No attempt data yet.</b><p>Start the Full IELTS Test. If you submit it or leave it early, unanswered and incorrect questions will appear here.</p></div>';return}const wrong=state.results.filter(r=>!r.ok);if(!wrong.length){$('#retryHost').innerHTML='<div class="panel"><b>No weak questions in the latest attempt.</b><p>Your latest attempt was 40/40.</p></div>';return}const status=state.attemptStatus==='exited'?'Latest attempt was exited early. Unanswered and incorrect questions are included.':'Missed and unanswered questions from your latest submitted attempt.';$('#retryHost').innerHTML=`<div class="panel"><b>${wrong.length} question(s) to retry</b><p class="muted">${status}</p>${wrong.map(r=>{const d=DATA.questions[String(r.q)];return `<div class="retry-item"><span><b>Q${r.q}</b> ${escapeHtml(d.prompt)}</span><button class="btn" data-retryq="${r.q}">Retry</button></div>`}).join('')}</div><div id="retryPractice"></div>`;$$('[data-retryq]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>retryQuestion(Number(b.dataset.retryq)))}
function retryQuestion(q){stopActiveClip();const d=DATA.questions[String(q)],opts=d.options||[];let body=`<div class="practice-card"><h2>Q${q}. ${escapeHtml(d.prompt)}</h2><button class="btn" onclick="playWindow(${d.timeStart},${d.timeEnd},this)">▶ Listen</button>`;if(opts.length)body+=`<div class="practice-options">${opts.map(o=>`<button class="practice-option" data-rchoice="${o.code}">${escapeHtml(o.text)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;else body+=`<div style="margin:12px 0"><input id="retryInput" style="padding:10px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:8px"><button class="btn primary" id="retryCheck">Check</button></div>`;body+='<div id="retryFeedback"></div></div>';$('#retryPractice').innerHTML=body;if(opts.length)$$('[data-rchoice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>showRetryFeedback(q,b.dataset.rchoice));else $('#retryCheck').onclick=()=>showRetryFeedback(q,$('#retryInput').value)}
function showRetryFeedback(q,v){const d=DATA.questions[String(q)],ok=answerOk(q,v);$('#retryFeedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback"><b class="${ok?'ok':'bad'}">${ok?'Correct':'Incorrect'}</b><br><b>Correct:</b> ${escapeHtml(d.answer)}<br><b>Evidence:</b> ${escapeHtml(d.evidence)}</div>`}
/* Event wiring */
loadStored();buildActivities();renderHub();
$('#startTestBtn').onclick=startExam;$('#volumeSlider').oninput=e=>$('#sharedAudio').volume=Number(e.target.value);$('#flagBtn').onclick=toggleFlag;$('#notesBtn').onclick=openNotes;$('#closeNotesBtn').onclick=closeNotes;$('#doneNotesBtn').onclick=closeNotes;$('#clearNoteBtn').onclick=clearCurrentNote;$('#noteTextarea').oninput=saveCurrentNote;$('#noteModal').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='noteModal')closeNotes()});$('#fullscreenBtn').onclick=()=>{const p=document.fullscreenElement?document.exitFullscreen():$('#examRoot').requestFullscreen();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(()=>toast('Fullscreen is not available'))};$('#optionsBtn').onclick=openOptions;$('#submitTest').onclick=()=>submitExam(false);$('#highlightBtn').onclick=highlightSelection;$('#removeHighlightBtn').onclick=removeHighlights;window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{stopAllAudio();try{sessionStorage.removeItem(NOTES_KEY)}catch(e){}});
// Support direct activity links in ZIP wrappers/hash
const hash=location.hash.replace('#','');if(ACTIVITIES.some(a=>a[0]===hash))setTimeout(()=>openActivity(hash),50);

// Keep confirmations inside the opaque frame; sandbox permissions remain unchanged.
function confirmInFrame(message,accept){showModal('<h2>'+escapeHtml(message)+'</h2><button class="btn" id="laConfirm">Confirm</button> <button class="btn" id="laCancel">Cancel</button>');$('#laConfirm').onclick=()=>{closeModal();accept()};$('#laCancel').onclick=closeModal;}
const originalSaveStored=saveStored;
saveStored=function(){originalSaveStored();const value=getStored();value.attemptKey=window.laAttemptKey||value.attemptKey;value.audioPosition=state.examStarted?($('#sharedAudio').currentTime||0):(value.audioPosition||0);localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(value));};
let checkpointSecond=-1;
$('#sharedAudio').addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{if(!state.examStarted)return;const second=Math.floor($('#sharedAudio').currentTime/5);if(second!==checkpointSecond){checkpointSecond=second;saveStored();}});
// Source practice answers and position survive leaving the page and another device.
const practiceKey='la_listening_test_14_practice';
let practice={};try{practice=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(practiceKey)||'{}')}catch{}
// The hub may paint before the authoritative checkpoint arrives. No activity
// can open until the parent hydrates storage and calls this allowlisted hook.
window.laHydrateOriginal=function(){loadStored();try{practice=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(practiceKey)||'{}')}catch{practice={}}};
const savePractice=()=>{const active=document.querySelector('.activity.active');if(!active||active.id==='activity-exam')return;const fields={};active.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select').forEach((el,i)=>{fields[el.id||el.name||String(i)]={value:el.value,checked:el.checked}});practice.views=practice.views||{};practice.views[active.id.replace('activity-','')]={scriptPart,reviewPart,mcqIndex,mcqStage,mcqSelected,completionIndex,matchingIndex,fields};localStorage.setItem(practiceKey,JSON.stringify(practice));};
const originalOpenActivity=openActivity;
openActivity=function(id){if(state.attemptStatus==='in_progress'&&id!=='exam'){toast('Resume and finish your current exam before opening study activities.');return;}const savedView=practice.views?.[id],restore=!!savedView;if(restore){scriptPart=savedView.scriptPart??scriptPart;reviewPart=savedView.reviewPart??reviewPart;mcqIndex=savedView.mcqIndex??mcqIndex;mcqStage=savedView.mcqStage??mcqStage;mcqSelected=savedView.mcqSelected??mcqSelected;completionIndex=savedView.completionIndex??completionIndex;matchingIndex=savedView.matchingIndex??matchingIndex;}originalOpenActivity(id);if(restore)document.querySelector('.activity.active').querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select').forEach((el,i)=>{const saved=savedView.fields?.[el.id||el.name||String(i)];if(saved){el.value=saved.value;if('checked'in el)el.checked=!!saved.checked;}});if(id==='exam'&&state.attemptStatus==='in_progress')$('#startTestBtn').textContent='Resume Test';};
for(const event of ['input','change','click'])document.addEventListener(event,()=>queueMicrotask(savePractice));
window.addEventListener('la-checkpoint',e=>{try{const saved=JSON.parse(e.detail[STORAGE_KEY]||'{}');if(saved.attemptStatus===state.attemptStatus&&['submitted','exited'].includes(state.attemptStatus)){state.results=saved.lastResults||state.results;if(state.submitted&&document.querySelector('#globalModal:not(.hidden) h2')?.textContent==='Test Results')showResults();}}catch{}});
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{if(state.examStarted)saveStored();savePractice();});

function laCourseUnit(){const active=document.querySelector('.activity.active');if(active?.id==='activity-vocab')return String(window.laVocabUnit||'').trim().slice(0,160);const card=active?.querySelector('.practice-card');const title=card?.querySelector('h2')?.textContent.trim()||'';const position=card?.querySelector('.muted')?.textContent.trim()||'';return title?(position+'|'+title).slice(0,160):'';}
function laCourseRecord(activity,answers){const clean=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(answers).filter(([key,value])=>key&&typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()));if(Object.keys(clean).length)window.laCourseWork?.(activity,clean);}
function laCoursePaint(status){
 if(!status)return;
 let panel=document.getElementById('la-course-progress');
 if(!panel){panel=document.createElement('p');panel.id='la-course-progress';panel.className='muted';panel.setAttribute('role','status');document.getElementById('activityCards')?.before(panel);}
 panel.textContent=status.complete?'Test completed. The next test is unlocked.':'Activities completed: '+status.completed+' / '+status.total;
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-open]').forEach(button=>{const result=status.activities[button.dataset.open];if(!result)return;let badge=button.querySelector('[data-course-status]');if(!badge){badge=document.createElement('span');badge.dataset.courseStatus='';badge.style.cssText='display:block;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;opacity:.8';button.append(badge);}badge.textContent=!result.available?(button.dataset.open==='retry'?'No weak questions':'Not available for this test'):result.complete?'✓ Completed':result.done+' / '+result.total;});
}
addEventListener('la-course-status',e=>laCoursePaint(e.detail));
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>laCoursePaint(window.laInitialCourseStatus));
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
 const button=event.target instanceof Element?event.target.closest('button'):null;
 const active=document.querySelector('.activity.active');if(!button||!active||button.disabled)return;
 const activity=active.id.replace('activity-',''),unit=laCourseUnit();let answers={};
 if(activity==='review'&&button.id==='checkReviewPart'){
  active.querySelectorAll('[data-review-input]').forEach(el=>answers[el.dataset.reviewInput]=el.value);
  active.querySelectorAll('[data-review-radio]:checked').forEach(el=>answers[el.dataset.reviewRadio]=el.value);
 }else if(activity==='script'&&['checkScriptPart','checkScript'].includes(button.id)){
  active.querySelectorAll('[data-gap]').forEach(el=>answers[scriptPart+':'+el.dataset.gap]=el.value);
 }else if(activity==='mcq'&&button.id==='checkMcq')answers[unit]=typeof mcqSelected==='undefined'?'':mcqSelected;
 else if(activity==='map'&&button.hasAttribute('data-mapopt'))answers[unit]=button.dataset.mapopt;
 else if(activity==='matching'&&button.hasAttribute('data-matchopt'))answers[unit]=button.dataset.matchopt;
 else if(activity==='multi'&&['checkMulti','multiCheck'].includes(button.id)){const picked=Array.from(active.querySelectorAll('[data-multiopt].selected,[data-multiopt]:checked,[data-multi-practice]:checked')).map(el=>el.dataset.multiopt||el.dataset.multiPractice);if(picked.length>=2)answers[unit]=picked.join(',');}
 else if(activity==='completion'&&button.id==='completionCheck')answers[unit]=document.getElementById('completionAnswer')?.value||'';
 else if(activity==='retry'&&button.id==='retryMultiCheck'){const range=/Questions\s*(\d+)\s*[-–]\s*(\d+)/i.exec(active.querySelector('#retryPractice h2')?.textContent||'');const picked=Array.from(active.querySelectorAll('[data-retry-multi]:checked')).map(el=>el.dataset.retryMulti);if(range&&picked.length===Number(range[2])-Number(range[1])+1)for(let q=Number(range[1]);q<=Number(range[2]);q++)answers[String(q)]=picked.join(',');}
 else if(activity==='vocab'&&button.hasAttribute('data-vopt'))answers[unit]=button.dataset.vopt;
 laCourseRecord(activity,answers);
},true);
const laOriginalRetryFeedback=showRetryFeedback;
showRetryFeedback=function(q,value){laOriginalRetryFeedback(q,value);laCourseRecord('retry',{[String(q)]:String(value)});};
